title: Curb Rights
description: Two rival food trucks share one generator and twelve feet of curb. Donna runs Donna's Diner-On-Wheels. Mr. Chen runs the taco window six feet behind her. Tonight they settle whose extension cord it is, live, while the power keeps flickering.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Tonight, two beloved local food trucks who park on the same block have agreed to come on the air and work things out, neighbor to neighbor. Donna, Mr. Chen, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: They share a generator, Ronnie. That's the part you skipped.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: One generator, two dreams. That's commerce, Barry. Donna, you reached out first.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: I did, Ronnie, and I'll keep it simple, sweetheart. The cord is mine. I bought it, I run it, and Chen's been plugging his little taco lights into MY cord.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: It is a shared cord, Donna. Always shared.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: ...It is not shared, sweetheart. <p:0.3> It is orange, it has my name on it in marker, and it lives under MY truck.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay, but whose generator is it, though?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: The generator is mine. I bought the generator. She bought the cord. This is balance.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Balance. He calls it balance. <p:0.3> Ronnie, his generator runs MY fryer. When he gets mad, sweetheart, he turns me off mid-fry.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that does sound serious. A man shouldn't have a hand on another woman's fryer.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: I turn it off because she unplugs my lights! Every night, the same. I plug in, lights go dark, I look, the cord is under HER truck.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Because it's MY cord, sweetheart! You don't drag a woman's cord six feet just to light up a sign that says, what does it say, Chen, say it.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: ...It says, Best Tacos On The Block.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: On the BLOCK. There it is. There's the knife, Ronnie. It's a two-truck block!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay so the sign is the real thing here. It's not the cord.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: It is the cord, Barry. The sign is just true.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: True?! Sweetheart, your line is twelve people long because I told my regulars your fish came in on a Tuesday and it is FRIDAY.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Donna, in fairness, that does sound like sabotage.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: It's marketing, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Marketing. She rerouted the line. <p:0.3> She put a little cone, Ronnie. A cone in front of my window that says, OUT OF CARNITAS, ASK DONNA.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: She made you a cone, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: And who moved my truck, Donna? Hmm? I park, I go for change, I come back, my truck is in the BUS ZONE. Forty dollar ticket. You pushed it.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Push a truck? Sweetheart, I'm a hundred and ten pounds, I couldn't push a truck if you greased it.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: You put it in NEUTRAL and you used the slope, Donna! I have the hill on camera!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He has the hill on camera, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Oh, you wanna do cameras? Who poured chili oil down my fryer vent, Chen? My whole truck smells like YOUR truck now! Customers think I went Mexican!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Good! Maybe finally somebody eats something with a flavor, Donna!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: FLAVOR?! My meatloaf has a Yelp page, sweetheart, it has a FOLLOWING!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Um, Ronnie? <p:0.3> The lights just went out in here. On our end. The studio.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's just the block flickering, Todd. They share a generator. It does that when they fight.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: She unplugged me AGAIN. Right now. On the radio.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: And your fryer just took MY power down with it, sweetheart, so we're even.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Cord!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Generator!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Sign's still true, Donna!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: MEATLOAF HAS A FOLLOWING!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait. <p:0.3> Wait, hang on. Donna, Chen, what's your last name? Both of you.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: ...Chen.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: ...Also Chen.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You're MARRIED?

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: ...For the trucks, Barry. It was a tax thing. <p:0.3> One L L C, two windows. The lawyer said it was smart.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: So technically, the cord is also the generator. <p:0.3> They are one business.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: ...Then who do I sue, sweetheart?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Yourself, Donna. <p:0.4> Us. You sue us.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well there it is, folks. One generator, one cord, one marriage, two windows. <p:0.3> Donna, Chen... that's just good neighboring. We'll be right back, soon as the lights come up.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, the lights are not coming up.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: She's still got the cord, Barry.
